title: A test leaves relay_ledger bound to a patched ledger_dir…
what: tests/test_metrics.py:138: MEDIUM: F3 a test leaves relay_ledger bound to a patched ledger_dir; this change only shields one victim test, the leak stays for every other relay_ledger test
why: An order-dependent red gate (30 Oct, branch of first-relay-setup-on-a-new-machine-fails): a test patch of relay_config.ledger_dir stays bound inside relay_ledger for the rest of the process; the branch shielded one victim test, the cause stays. A flaky test is a bug (quality-gate rule).
failing_case: Gate of 47efc720 (this branch): library tests FAILED in
test_hook_ledger.Ledger.test_has_start_scans_each_day_file_once_and_finds_either_day, and inert went red because the
probe run passed it: an order-dependent failure. relay_ledger does `from relay_config import claude_json, ledger_dir`
(lib/relay_ledger.py:24), so if relay_ledger is first imported while a test has relay_config.ledger_dir patched
(tests/test_metrics.py:138 is the only such patch), the module keeps that mock for the rest of the process. cfbde7a6
patches mod.relay_ledger.ledger_dir in the one failing test; any other test reading relay_ledger after it (for example
tests/test_transcripts_analysis.py:221 rl.ledger_dir()) still sees the stale folder.
Expected: no test leaves relay_ledger bound to another test's folder; the order of tests does not change a result.
pass_cases: 1. Run test_metrics then test_hook_ledger in one process (parallel_unittest with one worker, or unittest with both
modules): test_has_start... passes without the victim-side patch.
2. Same with test_metrics then test_transcripts_analysis: rl.ledger_dir() is under that test's RELAY_HOME.
3. relay_ledger.ledger_dir() in a fresh process still follows RELAY_HOME (the hook writes to $RELAY_HOME/ledger).

fact: 30 Oct: the same leak turned the landing gate of wt/the-front-reviews-code-itself-instead-of red (test_hook_ledger test_has_start_scans_each_day_file_once_and_finds_either_day failed, inert went red), on a branch that does not touch the ledger. Second red gate from this cause in one day.
